metadata.lesson: One source-neutral preparation can serve multiple locales while all translated copy, native glyph layers, narration and actual output reviews remain per language. ASS alpha must be rendered explicitly; inspect actual first candidate before accepting. Multi-clip montage perception can over-report a missing ending, so retain local duration/ASR counterevidence and review separately labeled final WAVs.
metadata.evidence_semantics: Embedded historical records are immutable observations. Their old path strings are origin labels, not live dependencies. Use only this manifest's files.
metadata.proof_boundary: Preserved text, feedback and actual observed image/audio evidence. Does not preserve every full-video frame or make unobserved claims pass.
